project_info.theme: cool-toned forced-perspective streetwear portrait in a modern city plaza
project_info.color_palette: black, slate gray, desaturated blue, glass cyan, and white sneaker accents

main_subject.detail: Adult bearded man in a black hooded sweatshirt, oversized black shield sunglasses, black cargo pants, and white sneakers, crouching naturally in an open city plaza.
main_subject.style: technical streetwear editorial with dynamic but non-threatening energy

composition_elements.text: no readable text, logo, or watermark
items: both open hands reaching toward the camera in a playful forced-perspective gesture
hands enlarged only moderately by a wide lens, with realistic anatomy
towering modern glass skyscrapers and gray stone paving
distant pedestrians kept small and naturally placed

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: desaturated cinematic grade, crisp city surfaces, restrained high contrast, modern urban scale

technical_specs.render_style: controlled wide-angle perspective, clear hands and face, realistic architecture, subtle grain

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical wide-angle streetwear editorial of an adult bearded man crouching naturally in a modern city plaza. He wears a black hooded sweatshirt, oversized black shield sunglasses, black cargo pants, and white sneakers. Frame him with both open hands reaching playfully toward the camera, using controlled 20mm forced perspective so the hands appear moderately larger while retaining realistic anatomy. Surround him with towering glass skyscrapers, gray stone paving, and a few small distant pedestrians. Use cool overcast daylight, a desaturated blue-gray cinematic grade, crisp urban surfaces, subtle grain, and dynamic but non-threatening energy. No readable text, logo, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, child, threatening gesture, distorted hands, exaggerated hands, extra fingers, deformed, sexualized pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, readable text, logo, watermark
